Exact ELF inspection, complete-artifact method/study replay and frozen Git ancestry verification require the complete experiment bundles and history.
Raw protocol captures, timing receipts, deterministic replay files and historical evidence manifests retain their collection bytes; supported per-boot derivations can be checked here.
This inventory does not hash itself, authenticate historical authorship, establish clock accuracy or qualify new hardware behavior.
Historical OS results, ledger and methods are project-owned. Exact relocation tables retain their recorded names; raw captures and original declarations keep their identities.

Generated capture mirrors/build databases, duplicate snapshots, resolved setup logs and superseded review narratives are retired with availability reasons. Current documentation and exact ABI excerpts are derivatives, not complete original inputs.
Schema-2 retired records mark unavailable publications that were added after original_head. They preserve null original hashes and do not authenticate the previous publication or Git history.
Publication relocation and omission checks do not grant full-artifact method admission. Original executable artifacts and freeze ancestry remain unavailable.
